patch.why: Leaves out its bundled LambDynamicLights API, which conflicts with the pack's mods.
One-byte change that lets the pack's title screen lay out every button itself.
Fixes its red dye recipe, which uses recipe syntax 1.21.1 can't read.

source.note: Its author only allows downloads from CurseForge itself, so this one has to be downloaded by hand.

patch.why: Removes its title screen mixin, which forces an editor button onto the pack's title screen.
Fixes its crafting table recipe, which uses recipe syntax 1.21.1 can't read.
Removes its camera ChunkMap mixin, which crashes on world load next to Immersive Portals (needed by the Portal Gun).
Declares it a data-only mod (lowcodefml), which NeoForge 1.21.1 needs to load it.
